missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Зверь' is a soft-stem masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'живёт'. 'Опасный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в лесу' sets the scene.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Зверя' is the accusative, equal to the genitive because 'зверь' is animate masculine. 'Большого' agrees in the animate accusative. A natural hunting sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Зверя' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that none are present. 'Ни одного' reinforces the emptiness. A core negation pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Зверю' is the dative, the creature receiving the food. 'Хлеба' is a partitive genitive after 'немного'. A warm everyday scene at the zoo.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 'Перед зверем' uses the instrumental form 'зверем' after 'перед' to mean in front of the animal. 'Стоял' agrees with the masculine subject 'мальчик'.

missions.phrase: Мы читали книгу о диком звере.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О звере' uses the prepositional form 'звере' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Диком' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A useful discussion frame.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Зверей' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Разных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в зоопарке' locates them. A natural quantity pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Звери' is the nominative plural subject of 'боятся'. 'Дикие' agrees in the plural, and 'людей' is the genitive object the verb requires. A clean generalisation.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of an animate noun. 'Зверей' is the accusative plural, equal to the genitive plural for animate nouns. 'Фотографировали' takes them as the object. A natural travel sentence.

Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Зверь' is nominative as the subject. 'Этот' agrees as masculine and 'умный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive card.
